name: draw_text
description: Type a text reply onto the page below the handwritten notes using a slow virtual keyboard (about 100 characters per second). Plain ASCII text only; use line breaks for structure. Do NOT use this tool when the page asks for a drawing, picture, sketch, diagram, table, plan or layout: those requests must be answered with the draw_svg tool, never with typed text, a text smiley or a description.

text.description: The complete reply to type. Plain ASCII only, no markdown, normally under 700 characters.
